nativeCommissionReference.notes: Reference to the existing native contract, not a compensation approval or override. V2 planning instead uses its own explicitly modeled commission after reserve. Actual commissions still require the existing approved policy and qualified order evidence.

assumptionNotes: Operating defaults and installation times are editable planning assumptions, not verified market research.
The base case is owner-operated: no imputed owner wage. Explicit paid-crew hourly/per-job costs are additional cash expenses, not deductions from the representative commission base.
Unknown travel time, acquisition cost and overhead stay unknown until reviewed. Zero overhead is not assumed.
V2 retained-margin and dollar floors apply per modeled job before advertising and overhead; they do not guarantee monthly profit for arbitrary operating spend.
V2 reserve is company-held money, not a cash expense. Show profit and spendable retained funds after reserve separately.
No pricing publication, checkout activation, legal-term changes or compensation approvals are authorized by this planning profile.
